projects.title: Secondary School Exhibition 2025
projects.description: Soldering at the Secondary School Exhibition 2025 in Trutnov.
projects.showcase: I came to the event to document the soldering work and the atmosphere on our school's the stand. I wanted to capture not just the result, but also the process, the focus, and the people around it.

projects.title: Flowering Cherry Trees
projects.description: Ornamental cherry trees blooming in City Park at the start of April.
projects.showcase: I went out to catch the first blossoms of spring, right as the ornamental cherry trees started opening up. I wanted close, quiet frames - petals catching the light, buds still closed next to flowers already in full bloom - rather than a wide shot of the whole tree.

projects.title: Model Railway Exhibition
projects.description: Miniature train exhibition at the Trutnov Town Hall.
projects.showcase: I came to photograph the model railway exhibition and wanted the miniature scenes to feel real - locomotives lit up, trains caught mid-motion, and enough depth of field to keep the illusion of scale intact.

projects.title: Maker Faire Brno 2025
projects.description: Participating in the Maker Faire Brno 2025 with my photography.
projects.showcase: I attended the Maker Faire Brno 2025 to document the innovative projects and the enthusiastic community of makers and enthusiasts.

projects.title: Gladiator Race 2026
projects.description: Documenting the exciting gladiator race event in Trutnov.
projects.showcase: I was one of the official photographers for the Gladiator Race 2026, capturing the insanity of the race, and the determination of the participants.
